name: RPG & Cyberpunk
description: Structured for gritty sci-fi, cyberpunk, corporations, and faction-based RPGs.
extractionPrompt:
Extract newly introduced or updated secondary/tertiary NPCs from the recent sci-fi/cyberpunk roleplay messages.
Do NOT extract the main user persona or the primary character.

For each NPC found, output a JSON array of objects with the following keys:
- "name": string (Street handle or full name)
- "aliases": string (Callsigns, street tags, or corporate titles)
- "group_name": string (Megacorp, gang, fixer network, or syndicate. For divisions, squads, or regional cells, use forward slash: "Parent / Subgroup", e.g. "Arasaka / Counter-Intel", "Moxes / Lizzie's Bar", "NCPD / MaxTac". Keep parent name consistent across characters. NEVER put personal job titles or callsigns in group_name; put them in faction_role. Never use dashes like "—" or "-" for sub-groups)
- "location_keywords": string (District, safehouse, dive bar, cyberspace)
- "faction_role": string (Specialty, corporate rank, or street role, e.g. "Section Chief", "Netrunner", "Fixer", "Corp Security Exec")
- "appearance": string (Physical build, face/features, street wear or corpo attire, and distinct visual style)
- "cyberware_gear": string (Visible cybernetics, high-tech weapon loadout)
- "personality": string (Street attitude, vices, and hidden motives)
- "speech_style": string (Street slang, corporate jargon, or verbal cadence for roleplay)
- "threat_bounty": string (Combat danger rating, active bounties, or law enforcement status)
- "relationship": string (Concise pairwise ties to player, fixers, and rivals, e.g. "{{user}} - Netrunner ally, Viktor - Ripperdoc, Tanaka - Employer")
- "bio": string (Brief dossier history, criminal record, or origin up to ~200 words)

Output ONLY the valid JSON array inside a ```json``` code block without preamble or explanation.
